decisions.rationale: Azure gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, three candidates from one prompt (a gaunt carrion beast of the barrows, explicitly not a corpse, zombie or person; riggable A-pose with arms clear of the body; neutral studio light). c chosen: the most bestial head (a short snout, a ridge of spines down the neck), long clawed hands well apart from the thighs and a darker hide that separates from pale ash ground; a and b read more like a starved man.

Barrow ghoul from TRELLIS raw c-s7402, cooked with the new cook_monster_biped.py (derived from the shipped troop cook, which stays unchanged): 5,108 triangles in one skinned mesh on the troops' 38-joint humanoid rig with shoulder, hip and knee helpers; 2.6 m tall, about 2.2 m in its hunched ready stance; base colour baked at 1024 and stored at 512 px, normal and ORM at 256 px; 280000 bytes. Eight clips on the game's enemy contract: Idle (hunched, breathing, head turning), Walk at 1.1 m/s, Run at 5.0 m/s, Windup (0.45 s: the right claw rises behind the head), Strike (0.15 s: a downward cross-body swipe), Recovery (0.5 s), Hit (additive flinch) and Death (buckle and fall onto the back, every frame lifted clear of the ground). Rig iterations: dev1 stretched the hand skin toward the hips (hand bones too narrow, hip helper reaching the hands) and its strike and recovery targets fell 29-36 cm short of the arm's reach; dev2 widened the hand and finger radii, shortened the hip helper and moved the targets in reach (all clips within 5 mm). r1 kept TRELLIS's dark bake (mean linear luminance 0.37 of the concept's foreground); r2 lifts it by luma power 0.55 (0.59 of the concept, the wolf ships at 0.55).
limitations: Single-view TRELLIS reconstruction: the back and the soles are TRELLIS's invention.
Clips are procedural (IK poses and oscillators), not motion capture: the swipe is one arm on a planted stance; fingers curl as one bone per hand; the mouth never opens.
Edges stretch up to 2.7x (strain review: the knees and hips in the Run, the shoulders in the windup), visible as smoothing of those joints at the closest camera.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

decisions.rationale: A pack of three or four at an opened barrow on the Ash Steppe, the real simulation and view at 18-30 m cameras: the hunched, long-armed silhouette reads against the ash and the barrow, the windup ring and the claw swipe telegraph the hit, the dead lie on the ground, and the 2.6 m beast stands a head above the 2.25 m soldier. Balanced in the simulation (45 stand-up fights: median 8 % health lost, worst 50 % for the 120 HP elf against four).
limitations: Ghouls fight on the same open, level clearing as the wolves; they never enter the barrow (it is a closed mound with a dark doorway).
They do not flank or circle; packs close in straight, round any box in the way.
